description.value:
Personalized Daughter In Law Gift, Welcome To Our Family, Wedding Keepsake For Bride Ring Dish

🌹 Hey, babes! 
I'm absolutely obsessed with my handmade ceramic dishes, and you will be too! They're totally customizable, so you can get one that's tailored just to your style.

🌹 DETAILS:
- Round Dish: Outside Diameter: 3.9 inches
- Heart Dish: Width x Height: 3.8 x 3.8 inches
- Wavy Square Dish: 3.5 x 3.5 inches
- Line Square Dish: 3.3 x 3.3 inches
- Big Line Square Dish: 4.1 x 4.1 inches

🌹 WHAT MAKES MY DISHES UNIQUE? 
The design is printed manually on the dish, which means it will last longer than the vinyl can and still look fabulous!

🌹 PERFECT FOR YOU
These cuties are perfect for keeping your most precious jewelry items safe and sound. Place them on your dresser, nightstand, or vanity, and you'll never lose track of your fave accessories.

🌹 GET CREATIVE
I love being creative, and I'd love to make a custom piece just for you! Just shoot me a message with your ideas.

🌹 HOW TO CARE FOR YOUR DISH
- Clean it gently with a soft cloth, no harsh chemicals
- Don't put it in the microwave or dishwasher, or use abrasive tools or strong cleaners
- Be careful not to stick tape to the printed surface

🌹 NOTE
Due to the manual nature, each piece may have a small difference in appearance

🌹 Discover more exquisite gifts by visiting:
https://www.etsy.com/shop/JaHandmadeArt

Thank you for your support—hope to see you again soon!
